en.title: Northwind Observatory
en.summary: A fictional observatory used to demonstrate source-linked encyclopedia reading.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Northwind Observatory is a synthetic example, not a claim about a real institution. It illustrates how an encyclopedia entry can have a stable subject identifier and clear source references.

sections.heading: Evidence and provenance
sections.body: The reference below is intentionally fictional. Production entries will require independently qualified source records, publication authorization and verifiable provenance.

sections.heading: Présentation
sections.body: L’Observatoire Northwind est un exemple synthétique, et non une affirmation sur une institution réelle. Il montre comment une entrée peut conserver un identifiant de sujet stable et des références explicites.

sections.heading: Preuves et provenance
sections.body: La référence ci-dessous est volontairement fictive. La publication réelle exigera des sources qualifiées, des droits vérifiés et une autorisation de diffusion.

en.title: Atlas of Imaginary Forests
en.summary: A sample multilingual entry that demonstrates how language fallback is disclosed.

sections.heading: Description
sections.body: This invented atlas is a demonstration of a multilingual reading interface. Its absence in French is intentional: readers can see that English fallback was used.
